bootstrap.method: paired seed-cluster percentile; ratio-of-sums recomputed per draw
bootstrap.interval_scope: preregistered rank criterion and last-place guardrail; auxiliary intervals descriptive
bootstrap.independent_units: seeds; all four rotations in both arms resampled together

counting_conventions.hands: actor-hand exposures; all start_kyoku including abortive draws
counting_conventions.wins: each winner once per hand; multiple ron credits each winner
counting_conventions.deal_ins: payer once per hand regardless of the number of ron winners; tsumo is not a deal-in
counting_conventions.riichi_rate: accepted riichi hands / actor-hand exposures; declaration rate reported separately
counting_conventions.call_rate: hands with chi/pon/daiminkan / actor-hand exposures; repeated calls count once, ankan alone does not count
counting_conventions.points_and_ranks: integer final points and authoritative engine ranks; no re-ranking of ties
counting_conventions.rates: ratio of pooled numerators and denominators, recomputed jointly per seed-cluster bootstrap draw
counting_conventions.replays: analyze separately for reproducibility; never pool repeated runs as independent samples
